page.overview:
Who is Krepp?

Krepp was a priest of Kreve in charge of a temple in Rinde. He was also a member of the Rinde town council which advised the mayor, Neville, and spoke often and at length against Yennefer in his sermons.

He knows a secret tempel language, which enable him to translate for Geralt the 'exorcism', the latter had used against a djinn.
